title: Paper Chromatography (PC) & Thin-Layer Chromatography (TLC)

pedagogy.core_lab_linkage: Paper chromatography of amino acids & Thin-Layer chromatography of analgesics
governing_formulas: R_f = \frac{\text{Distance traveled by solute}}{\text{Distance traveled by solvent front}} \quad

cognitive_progression.level_1_remember: Define fundamental laws, terminology, and bounds of Paper Chromatography (PC) & Thin-Layer Chromatography (TLC).
cognitive_progression.level_2_understand: Explain underlying physical mechanisms, instrumentation, and energy transitions.
cognitive_progression.level_3_apply: Solve quantitative analytical calculations using $$R_f = \frac{\text{Distance traveled by solute}}{\text{Distance traveled by solvent front}} \quad | \quad R_{st} = \frac{\text{Distance solute}}{\text{Distance standard solute}}$$.
cognitive_progression.level_4_analyze: Interpret spectral shifts, evaluate deviations, and troubleshoot analytical anomalies.

pedagogical_boundary.retained_scope: Principles of planar chromatography, paper chromatography (cellulose support with bound water as partition stationary phase), thin-layer chromatography (silica gel G, alumina, cellulose sorbents with binders), preparation of TLC plates, activation, spotting techniques, development modes (ascending, descending, two-dimensional), chamber saturation and edge effects, visualization reagents (destructive e.g. ninhydrin, sulfuric acid charring; non-destructive e.g. UV 254nm fluorescence quenching, iodine vapor), pharmaceutical purity testing.
pedagogical_boundary.non_forced_clinical_rationale: Focuses on planar chromatographic mechanics, stationary phase binding, solvent eluotropic strength, and spot visualization chemistry for pharmaceutical identification.
pedagogical_boundary.excluded_scope: High-performance thin layer chromatography (HPTLC) automated scanning densitometry.

vision_filtering.policy: Separate core educational diagrams from decorative slide artifacts
